title: Query fails with EXCEEDED_LOCAL_MEMORY_LIMIT on 474 when JVM set higher
body:
```
SELECT kind, max(length(payload)) max_payload_len
FROM hive.default.test_payload_tbl
GROUP BY 1
```

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
I don’t think the aggregation is the problem here. Even with the changes for caching hash values, single varchar aggregations will use less memory than before the aggregation changes.

Based on the error message, it looks like the scan filter and project operator is using 25GB while the aggregation is using ~8MB of that memory, so maybe related to the SourcePage changes that landed recently?

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
Surprisingly, it's not about the JVM but about the machine RAM - above 64GB and issue happens regardless the JVM settings.

**r5.large** (16GB RAM) 9GB JVM - succeed 
**r5.xlarge**  (32GB RAM) 19GB JVM - succeed
**r6a.2xlarge** (64GB RAM) 42GB  JVM - succeed

**r6a.4xlarge** (128GB RAM) 86GB JVM - failed `io.trinio.trino.ExceededMemoryLimitException: Query exceeded per-node memory limit of 25.80GB [Allocated: 25.80GB, Delta: 10.52MB, Top Consumers: {ScanFilterAndProjectOperator=25.78GB, HashAggregationOperator=8.37MB, PagePartitioner=4.05MB}]`

**r6a.4xlarge** (128GB RAM) 9GB JVM - failed `io.trino.ExceededMemoryLimitException: Query exceeded per-node memory limit of 2.70GB [Allocated: 2.69GB, Delta: 14.77MB, Top Consumers: {ScanFilterAndProjectOperator=2.68GB, HashAggregationOperator=8.22MB, PagePartitioner=4.03MB}]`

**r6a.4xlarge** (128GB RAM) 19GB JVM - failed `io.trino.ExceededMemoryLimitException: Query exceeded per-node memory limit of 5.70GB [Allocated: 5.69GB, Delta: 13.01MB, Top Consumers: {ScanFilterAndProjectOperator=5.68GB, HashAggregationOperator=7.32MB, PagePartitioner=4.01MB}]`

I've realized that the issue relates to the **number and size** of input files:
